figures.caption: FIG. 1. A higher-order dependency becomes pairwise after projection. (a) Exact enumeration at K = 1.8 gives 0.823 bits of connected third-order information at the fine scale and 0.261 bits of pairwise mutual information after the disjoint coincidence projection x = b1, z = b2 ∧ b3. The projected variables are independent at K = 0. (b) The information that survives as pairwise depends on the map: an XNOR/parity projection retains all of I(3), whereas the coincidence map retains only part.

FIG. 2. Direct dependencies become more complete along an exact cascade. (a) Blue bars show F for the coordinateinvariant categorical-additive family; pink shows the residual share. Purple diamonds show the more restrictive linear-moment family, which yields 55.0%, 81.3% and 98.9%. (b) Coarse-graining reduces the available information Iavail, the captured direct information Idir and, more sharply, the conditional-KL residual Ihigher. Values are exact sums over all 64 input states.

FIG. 3. Organized multi-contact features improve held-out approximation. (a) Mean held-out MSE for a linear point neuron, a three-subunit model with shuffled contacts and a three-subunit model with contacts aligned to the target’s pair structure. Error bars are 95% normal intervals across 100 independent train–test trials (6,000 samples in each split). (b) Mean held-out MSE of a generic fixed sigmoid random-feature network. The first tested width whose mean reaches the aligned model is 40. Shading shows 95% normal intervals across 40 trials.

FIG. 4. Approximation and effective dimension grow in a nested hierarchy. (a) Mean held-out MSE as progressively more nonlinear sigma–pi subunits are exposed from the same architecture; the dashed line is the direct-input point baseline. Error bars and baseline shading are 95% normal intervals across 60 independent architectures and train–test sets (5,000 samples per split). (b) Normalized inverse error and normalized effective rank with log-space power-law fits. Exponent intervals are 95% percentile-bootstrap intervals over trials (2,000 resamples).
